quote: Drivers of vehicles proceeding in opposite directions shall pass each other keeping to the right, and upon highways having width for not more than one line of traffic in each direction, each driver shall give to the other at least one-half of the paved portion of the highway as nearly as possible.

activation.condition: Vehicles proceeding in opposite directions; paved-half clause applies where highway width permits no more than one line of traffic in each direction

obligation.description: Pass each other keeping to the right and, on the narrow-width branch, give the other at least half the paved portion as nearly as possible

judgment_calls_needed.note: Original pavement, full vehicle extents and actual physical road constraints require independent review; the body-footprint fraction is not the statutory allocation.
